description: This file contains classes and functions for handling input streams, encoding detection, and character processing for HTML parsing, specifically within the html5lib library's third-party WPT tools.

classes.name: BufferedStream
classes.description: Provides buffering for streams that lack native buffering, allowing reading and seeking operations.

classes.name: HTMLUnicodeInputStream
classes.description: Provides a Unicode character stream for HTML tokenization, handling encoding detection, chunking, and line/column tracking.

classes.name: HTMLBinaryInputStream
classes.description: Extends HTMLUnicodeInputStream to handle raw binary streams, detect encoding via BOM, meta tags, or chardet, and convert to Unicode.

classes.name: EncodingBytes
classes.description: A string-like object with position tracking, used for parsing encoding declarations.

classes.name: EncodingParser
classes.description: Mini parser to detect character encoding from HTML meta tags.

methods.name: HTMLInputStream
methods.description: Factory function that returns either a Unicode or binary HTML input stream based on source type.

methods.name: HTMLUnicodeInputStream
methods.description: Initializes a Unicode stream, handles chunk reading, character decoding, and error reporting.

methods.name: HTMLBinaryInputStream
methods.description: Initializes a binary stream, detects encoding, and converts to Unicode for HTML parsing.

methods.name: detectEncoding
methods.description: Detects encoding via BOM, meta tags, or chardet, with fallback to default.

methods.name: detectBOM
methods.description: Detects BOM at start of stream to determine encoding.

methods.name: detectEncodingMeta
methods.description: Parses initial bytes to find encoding declaration in meta tags.

methods.name: changeEncoding
methods.description: Changes stream encoding and resets stream if needed.
